lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular centroids are visible in vertical columns posterior to the gill region, forming a regular grid-like spatial arrangement with approximately 4-5 spots per vertical column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a clear Cartesian grid where the blobs act as anchor nodes at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient characterized by high-intensity light on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are attached to the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin; the pectoral fin itself displays a dense cluster of smaller, high-intensity spots compared to the lateral flank.
